prompt.description: The prompt. Supports file paths and environment variables.

output.description: Optional output path for modified files (Tool mode only)

dst.description: Optional destination path for the result, will substitute ${MODEL_NAME} and ${ROUTER} in the path. Optional, used for "completion" mode

each.description: Glob pattern to run for each matching file

disableTools.description: List of specific tools to disable

tools.description: List of tools to use. Can be built-in tool names or paths to custom tool files. Default: fs,git,interact,terminal,search,web,email,user

include.description: Comma separated glob patterns or paths, eg --include=src/*.tsx,src/*.ts --include=package.json

router.description: Router to use: openai or openrouter

mode.description:
Chat completion mode:
	 completion, tools, assistant.
          [32m[1mcompletion[22m[39m: no support for tools, please use --dst parameter to save the output.
          [32m[1mtools[22m[39m: allows for tools to be used, eg 'save to ./output.md'. Not all models support this mode.
          [32m[1massistant[22m[39m: : allows documents (PDF, DOCX, ...) to be added but dont support tools. Use --dst to save the output. Supported files :

profile.description: Path to profile for variables. Supports environment variables.

config.description: Path to JSON configuration file (API keys). Supports environment variables.

preferences.description: Path to preferences file, eg: location, your email address, gender, etc. Supports environment variables.

filters.description:
List of filters to apply to the output.
         Used only in completion mode and a given output file specified with --dst. 
         It unwraps by default any code or data in Markdown. 
         Choices:
	JSON,JSONUnescape,JSONPretty,AlphaSort,code,JSONParse,trim

dry.description: Dry run - only write out parameters without making API calls
